entities.summary: The California Institute of Integral Studies (CIIS) is a private graduate school in San Francisco. Founded in 1968 as the California Institute of Asian Studies, the school adopted its current name in 1980. CIIS has been regionally accredited by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges since 1981.
